timeline.title: A-Levels: Maths, Further Maths, Biology, Computer Science
timeline.description: Studying Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Biology and Computer Science at A-Level (AQA). Further Maths and FM Pure have been the heaviest focus of revision.

timeline.title: Somerset Guitar Works
timeline.summary: Running the e-commerce side of a second-hand guitar business.
timeline.description: Closely involved in running Somerset Guitar Works, a second-hand guitar retail business. Built and maintain the Squarespace storefront: custom product listing pages, tag-based filtering, responsive layout fixes and injected JavaScript for cart and navigation behaviour.

timeline.title: Graph Transformation Animator
timeline.summary: A pygame tool that animates function transformations.
timeline.description: A Python + pygame application that animates graph transformations (shifts, stretches, reflections) for arbitrary functions. Debugged a subtle bug where x-axis shifts were being converted to radians even for non-trigonometric functions. Shipped as a web build via pygbag and as a Windows executable via PyInstaller.

timeline.title: Spotify Playlist → MP3 Sorter
timeline.summary: Script that files MP3s into folders using a Spotify export.
timeline.description: A Python script that reads a Spotify CSV export and sorts a local MP3 library into playlist-named folders, copying tracks that belong to multiple playlists and moving matched originals into a _sorted_originals folder to keep the source library tidy.

timeline.title: FactsApp
timeline.summary: An iOS app built with SwiftUI and SwiftData.
timeline.description: An in-progress iOS app built with SwiftUI and SwiftData. Currently working through a schema migration issue: moving relationship properties to optional arrays for iCloud compatibility broke data creation across the app, which is being fixed via a formal SchemaMigrationPlan.
